R9 — SND10 sound-bank census across the installed families (read-only, 2026-09-20).

Per bank: container format (SBle / SBKR), DSET/record counts, field-storage census, whether every record's offset lands on
an SNS header block (validated by seeking the .sbr data chunk or the sibling .sbs), the SNR codec / rate / channel census
of the validated samples (sampled: up to `--sample` records per bank, default 300, plus first/last), duration agreement
(.DUR vs num_samples / rate where both exist). Sources: the extracted PS4 trees (`databigs/Extracted/.../kettle/audio`)
of the seven PS4 installs and the loose PS3 `USRDIR/audio` trees (12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / Legacy).

Usage: python snd10_census.py <out.json> [--sample N] [--only ps4|ps3]
